text: Figure 4.1: Placement of the IPduM in the AUTOSAR layered architecture. I-PDU multiplexing means using the same PCI of an I-PDU with more than one unique layout of its SDU. A selector field is a part of the SDU of the multiplexed I-PDU. It is used to distinguish the different layouts of the multiplexed I-PDUs from each other. Multiplexing of I-PDUs is currently known from CAN, but is not restricted to this com- munication system. The I-PDU Multiplexer Module is responsible to combine appropriate I-PDUs received from COM via IPDU-router to new, multiplexed I-PDUs sent back to the I-PDU Router on sender-side. On receiver-side it is responsible to interpret the content of multiplexed I-PDUs and provide COM via IPDU-router with its appropriate separated I-PDUs by taking into account the value of the selector field.
